key_catalyst: Rare hawkish Fed triple dissent accompanied by a 10-year Treasury yield spike to 4.70%
reasoning: The Fed’s rare three-dissent hold and the 10-year yield’s jump to 4.70% represent an unresolved escalation in rate risk. Today’s resilience was driven primarily by Microsoft and semiconductors, while Meta’s collapse showed AI-capex concerns remain active. Similar rate and capex pressure weighed on QQQ from July 24 through July 29, leaving material overnight catch-up risk.
